The game is in the `immortal-barons-…` archives. The `ib-sysop-…` archives
contain the [Sysop Panel](https://andy5995.github.io/immortal-barons/sysop-panel/),
an optional graphical tool for troubleshooting and administration. It is mostly
for League Coordinators and sysops in a league, but it can also help a sysop
running a local game.
